# TOP CANDIDATE

> TOP CANDIDATE (https://www.topcandidatebd.com) is the job application platform for Bangladesh. It makes applying to a job easy: for every job you apply to, paste the job post and get a complete application kit built for that one job — a tailored resume, a cover letter, a recruiter email, a LinkedIn connection note, and interview preparation in English and Bangla (বাংলা). You fill in your profile once; each new application then takes about a minute. The first resume is free; after that, 5 complete applications cost ৳200 (about ৳40 each), paid with bKash. No credit card, no subscription.

Also known as: Top Candidate, Top Candidate BD, TopCandidate, topcandidatebd, টপ ক্যান্ডিডেট.

TOP CANDIDATE is not a generic resume builder. A resume builder gives you one document to send everywhere; TOP CANDIDATE gives you everything you send for ONE job — resume, letter, outreach messages and interview prep — all built from that job's post so they tell the same story.

## The application kit

- **Tailored resume / CV** — your summary, bullets and skills reordered and rewritten around the job post. ATS-friendly single-column templates (Classic, Modern, Serif, Compact, Executive). Exports to PDF and Word (.docx). Details: https://www.topcandidatebd.com/resume-maker
- **Cover letter** — 250–400 words, written for the specific role and company, with no "Dear Sir/Madam" boilerplate. Exports to PDF and Word. Details: https://www.topcandidatebd.com/cover-letter
- **Recruiter email** — a short email to the hiring manager, with a subject line. Details: https://www.topcandidatebd.com/job-application-email
- **LinkedIn note** — a connection request under 280 characters. Details: https://www.topcandidatebd.com/job-application-email
- **Interview preparation** — 6–8 questions picked for the role, each with why it is asked and how to answer, in English and বাংলা. Details: https://www.topcandidatebd.com/interview-preparation

## Also included

- **One profile, every application** — fill it in once, or import an existing CV (PDF or Word). Experience written in plain words, even Banglish, becomes clear English bullet points.
- **Master resume** — a general resume built from the profile, free.
- **Job search suggestions** — ready-made searches on Bdjobs, LinkedIn and remote job boards, based on the profile.
- **Every application saved** — each kit stays in the account to reopen, edit and download.
- **Bilingual** — the whole platform works in English and Bangla. Resumes stay in English, which is what recruiters and applicant-tracking systems in Bangladesh expect.

## How it works

1. Sign up (email or Google) and complete your profile once — or import your existing CV.
2. Paste the job description from Bdjobs, LinkedIn, a company site or an email.
3. Get the complete application kit in about a minute; edit, download and send.

## Pricing

- First resume: free (sign up and complete your profile).
- Application pack: ৳200 BDT for 5 complete applications. Each application = tailored resume + cover letter + recruiter email + LinkedIn note + interview prep for one job.
- Payment: bKash. Pay per pack; nothing renews automatically.

## Who it is for

Students, fresh graduates and experienced professionals applying for jobs in Bangladesh, and Bangladeshis applying for remote roles.
